import pytest
from datetime import date

from late_fee import LateFeeCalculator  # fix import path


# --- date map (2026) ---
# Jan 5 Mon ... Jan 9 Fri | Jan 12-16 | Jan 19-23 | Jan 24 Sat
DUE = date(2026, 1, 5)          # Monday
GRACE_END = date(2026, 1, 17)   # exactly 10 weekdays counted
ELEVEN = date(2026, 1, 20)      # 11 weekdays -> 1 billable
FIFTEEN = date(2026, 1, 24)     # 15 weekdays -> 5 billable


def calc(today):
    return LateFeeCalculator(today=today)


# ---------- _weekday_days_between ----------

def test_zero_when_end_before_start():
    assert calc(DUE)._weekday_days_between(date(2026, 1, 10), date(2026, 1, 5)) == 0


def test_zero_when_end_equals_start():
    assert calc(DUE)._weekday_days_between(DUE, DUE) == 0


def test_weekend_days_not_counted():
    # Fri -> Mon: only Fri counts
    assert calc(DUE)._weekday_days_between(date(2026, 1, 9), date(2026, 1, 12)) == 1


def test_full_week_counts_five():
    assert calc(DUE)._weekday_days_between(DUE, date(2026, 1, 12)) == 5


# ---------- balance guard ----------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("balance", [0, -1, -100000])
def test_no_fee_for_nonpositive_balance(balance):
    assert calc(FIFTEEN).compute_fee_cents(balance, DUE) == 0


# ---------- grace period ----------

def test_no_fee_when_due_date_in_future():
    assert calc(date(2026, 1, 1)).compute_fee_cents(1_000_000, DUE) == 0


def test_no_fee_when_today_equals_due_date():
    assert calc(DUE).compute_fee_cents(1_000_000, DUE) == 0


def test_no_fee_at_exactly_grace_boundary():
    # 10 weekdays late -> billable_days == 0
    assert calc(GRACE_END).compute_fee_cents(1_000_000, DUE) == 0


# ---------- normal prorated fee ----------

def test_prorated_fee_five_billable_days():
    # 1_000_000c * (0.015/30) * 5 = 2500
    assert calc(FIFTEEN).compute_fee_cents(1_000_000, DUE) == 2500


def test_rounds_half_up():
    # 2_001_000 * 0.0005 * 1 = 1000.5 -> 1001
    assert calc(ELEVEN).compute_fee_cents(2_001_000, DUE) == 1001


# ---------- minimum fee ----------

def test_minimum_fee_applies_when_raw_fee_small():
    # 200_000c * 0.0005 * 1 = 100 -> bumped to 500
    assert calc(ELEVEN).compute_fee_cents(200_000, DUE) == 500


def test_min_fee_beats_cap_on_tiny_balance():
    # cap = 250c but MIN_FEE 500c wins -> fee exceeds 25% cap (documents current behavior)
    assert calc(FIFTEEN).compute_fee_cents(1000, DUE) == 500


def test_fee_just_above_minimum_not_clamped():
    # 1_100_000 * 0.0005 * 1 = 550
    assert calc(ELEVEN).compute_fee_cents(1_100_000, DUE) == 550


# ---------- maximum cap ----------

def test_fee_capped_at_25_percent():
    # ~6 years late: raw fee way over cap
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    assert calc(today).compute_fee_cents(100_000, date(2020, 1, 6)) == 25_000


def test_cap_exact_boundary_not_exceeded():
    balance = 100_000
    fee = calc(date(2026, 1, 1)).compute_fee_cents(balance, date(2020, 1, 6))
    assert fee <= int(balance * LateFeeCalculator.MAX_FEE_FRACTION)


# ---------- constructor ----------

def test_default_today_is_date_today():
    assert LateFeeCalculator()._today == date.today()


def test_explicit_today_overrides_default():
    assert LateFeeCalculator(today=DUE)._today == DUE
